definitions.gloss: same age group; same generation; peers
definitions.explanation: People who belong to the same age bracket or generation. Used to describe someone of roughly the same age, not necessarily the exact same year.

examples.japanese: {同年代|どうねんだい}の{友人|ゆうじん}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: I have many friends of the same age.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}とは{同年代|どうねんだい}だと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think she's about the same age as me.

examples.japanese: {同年代|どうねんだい}の{人|ひと}たちと{話|はな}すと、{共通|きょうつう}の{話題|わだい}が{見|み}つかりやすい。
examples.english: When I talk with people of the same generation, it's easy to find common topics.

notes:
Composed of {同|どう} (same) and {年代|ねんだい} (age group/era). Refers to people who are roughly the same age — not necessarily born in the same year, but within the same general bracket (typically within about 5 years).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同年代|どうねんだい}の{人|ひと}: person of the same age group
- {同年代|どうねんだい}の{子供|こども}: children of the same age
- {同年代|どうねんだい}と{比|くら}べて: compared with one's age group
- {同年代|どうねんだい}の{平均|へいきん}: average for the age group

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {同世代|どうせだい}: same generation — very close in meaning but emphasizes generational identity (shared cultural experiences) rather than just age
- {同年齢|どうねんれい}: same age — refers to the exact same age, more precise than {同年代|どうねんだい}
- {同期|どうき}: same year/cohort — people who entered a school or company in the same year
